subject: Vendor enrollment: Storica AP CSV spec & vendor ID (PO mapping)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@storica-italia.it>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment: Storica AP CSV spec & vendor ID (PO mapping)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the quick connect on the onboarding call yesterday. Per our discussion, attaching the Redwood vendor packet for Storica and a copy of our EU VAT certificate. Can you confirm the steps needed to register Redwood as a vendor in Storica's vendor portal so that future invoices can include a Storica Vendor ID and always map to the customer PO?

Two quick asks to keep the validation moving:
- Can you share Storica's preferred invoice CSV spec (column names and required/optional flags) for bulk invoice ingestion? We typically upload as CSV to your portal/SFTP and want to make sure fields align (PO number, invoice number, invoice date, net amount, VAT amount, currency, supplier vendor id).
- Please confirm whether Storica issues the external Vendor ID (the numeric Supplier ID that must appear in the CSV) after you receive VAT and bank details, or whether we should request it up-front.

Attachments included: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_Storica.pdf (filled vendor onboarding form), Company_EU-VAT-Cert.pdf (VAT certificate).

Preferred remit: Redwood prefers EUR bank transfer (SEPA). If you need our IBAN/beneficiary format in a specific template, let us know.

Appreciate the help — happy to upload anything directly into your vendor portal if you send the registration link.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_Storica.pdf]
[Attachment: Company_EU-VAT-Cert.pdf]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@storica-italia.it>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Storica AP Team <ap-team@storica-italia.it>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Storica AP CSV spec & vendor ID (PO mapping)

Ciao Rachel,

Thanks for sending the packet — we reviewed the VAT certificate and the vendor form. To create the external Supplier ID in our system we will need the company bank details (IBAN + BIC) and a scanned VAT registration extract that includes the VAT number issue date (your PDF was helpful but our procurement requires the official extract). Once we have those we can create your supplier record; typical turnaround is 2-3 business days.

Please note Storica requires the following invoice fields in the CSV import:
- supplier_vendor_id (assigned by Storica, numeric) — REQUIRED
- customer_po_number — REQUIRED (must match PO format ST-########)
- invoice_number — REQUIRED
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD) — REQUIRED
- net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount — REQUIRED (two-decimal, dot separator)
- currency (ISO 4217) — REQUIRED
- remit_account_reference (free text) — OPTIONAL

We attached our PO template and an example CSV. Important: do not submit invoices without the assigned supplier_vendor_id or they will be rejected by the ingestion job.

Portal registration link: https://portal.storica-italia.it/vendor/register — after you register we will send a verification email and provide a temporary vendor number to use for test uploads.

Attachments: Storica_PO_Template.xlsx (template + CSV example).

Let us know when you've uploaded the bank extract and we'll prioritize creation. Also indicate whether Storica should apply reverse-charge on your invoices (if you prefer we can mark your record accordingly).

Grazie,
Elena Rossi
Head of Supplier Onboarding — Storica Retail
[Attachment: Storica_PO_Template.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@storica-italia.it>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Storica AP CSV spec & vendor ID (PO mapping)

Hi Elena — thanks, we uploaded the requested docs and test files this morning.

Summary of what we submitted into the Storica vendor portal:
- Completed vendor registration form (matches the packet Rachel sent).
- Bank details: IBAN: XX00REDW00000012345678, BIC: REDWIT22 (please treat as placeholder until you confirm).
- Scanned VAT extract: Company_EU-VAT-Cert.pdf (contains VAT number and issue date).
- Sample invoice CSV uploaded to the test area (file: sample_invoice_upload.csv) with the fields you listed.

Next steps from our side:
- Please confirm the temporary supplier_vendor_id assigned for testing so we can run a single test ingest.
- We also attached a signed PDF authorizing SEPA payments and a DocuSign signature request (link below) to complete banking verification.

Open question: for cross-border EU supplies, do you want suppliers flagged for "reverse-charge" at registration, or does Storica prefer to handle VAT per-invoice? We can mark all Redwood invoices reverse-charge if that speeds approval — let us know preference.

Links:
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rooms/REDWD-2026-331
- Test SFTP (drop zone): sftp.storica-italia.it/inbound/test (we uploaded sample CSV there as well)

Thanks again — please reply with the temporary supplier ID and whether the reverse-charge flag will be set.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_invoice_upload.csv]
